scripts.build:lambda: bunx esbuild lambda/pre-token-allowlist/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/pre-token-allowlist/index.js && bunx esbuild lambda/api-assets/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/api-assets/index.js && bunx esbuild lambda/api-asset-by-id/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/api-asset-by-id/index.js && bunx esbuild lambda/api-combos/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/api-combos/index.js && bunx esbuild lambda/mediaconvert-status/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/mediaconvert-status/index.js && bunx esbuild lambda/upload-trigger/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --outfile=.dist/lambda/upload-trigger/index.js
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc -p lambda/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.synth: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk synth
scripts.deploy:auth: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerAuthStack --require-approval never --parameters GoogleOAuthClientId=$GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID --parameters GoogleOAuthClientSecret=$GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
scripts.deploy:data: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerDataStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:storage: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerStorageStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:streaming: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerStreamingStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:darenkeck-site: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerDarenkeckSiteStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:api: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerApiStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:processing: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerProcessingStack --require-approval never
scripts.deploy:observability: bun run build && bun run build:lambda && node ./node_modules/aws-cdk/bin/cdk deploy MediaManagerObservabilityStack --require-approval never --parameters BudgetAlertEmail=$BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL --parameters MonthlyBudgetUsd=$MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD
